title: Agent Bricks documentation for code-first agent development
body:
The Agent Bricks documentation now centers on building, deploying, and running custom agents in code. See [Develop agents on Databricks](/aws/en/agents):

* **Agent compute stack**: New pages describe how a deployed agent's framework or harness, agent server, and agent runtime fit together. See [Deploy agents on Databricks](/aws/en/agents/deploy).
* **`DurableAgentServer` and Agent Runtime**: `DurableAgentServer` serves agents through the invocation API, with synchronous, streaming, and background runs, persistent run state, and crash recovery. Agent Runtime runs it on Databricks Apps. See [Agent Server](/aws/en/agents/deploy/agent-server) and [Agent Runtime](/aws/en/agents/deploy/agent-runtime).
* **Querying agents**: The query guide is organized by agent server, starting with the invocation API. See [Query agents deployed on Databricks](/aws/en/agents/query-llms).
* **Legacy offerings**: Offerings that are no longer recommended for new agents, including the MLflow `AgentServer`, `LongRunningAgentServer`, and agents deployed to Model Serving, are now in a Legacy section that maps each one to its replacement. See [Legacy agent offerings](/aws/en/agents/legacy).
